[Second entry:] In the year one thousand nine hundred and one, on the eighth day of July, in the Plungė Roman Catholic parish church, the local vicar Fr. Tomaszewicz baptised a child named Kazimir with all the rites of the Sacrament.

issues.en: Two baptism entries are merged in one row (Susanna and Kazimir, both 8 July). Several surnames, the first birth month and the manor name are garbled.
issues.lt: Vienoje eilutėje sujungti du krikšto įrašai (Zuzana ir Kazimieras, abu liepos 8 d.). Kelios pavardės, pirmasis gimimo mėnuo ir palivarko pavadinimas iškreipti.
